title: Automated Betriebsform
event: At opening, the Kaufhaus's operational program kicks in: overhead tracks hum, long aisles slide on rails and fold like accordion walls, escalators briefly reverse and leave a narrow perforated metal channel across the marble floor; slit spotlights narrow and chase along the new passage toward the deli/refrigerated wing.
consequence: A long perforated metal channel (grating) now bisects the floor, directing condensation and small drips toward the refrigerated wing.
nextHook: The grated channel collects condensation and a dark red smear pools at its far end toward the refrigerated displays.
stillPrompt: Wide interior shot of a recognizable Kaufhaus atrium: shifting aisles folded into accordion walls, a narrow perforated metal channel across polished tile, thin spotlights cutting through dim ceiling. No people, no text or logos.
videoPrompt: 5s low dolly forward along the new grated channel as spotlights sweep; mechanized racks slide aside and the channel leads toward the deli/refrigerated section, ambient mechanical hum.
cameraCue: After the reconfiguration, low tracking dolly along the grated channel toward the refrigerated wing, revealing the channel's pool.

title: Fleisch on the Shelves
event: Refrigerated displays populate with dense, red-wet bundles — fabric-wrapped forms and faux-packaging that gleam like flesh under the slit lights; condensation beads and thin red streaks run down the glass and drip into the grated channel.
consequence: A dark red smear runs from a refrigerated case into the grated channel and pools at a seam where a crate has been shifted.
nextHook: The pooled smear trickles under a knocked crate, seeping out beneath its splintered edge toward the central aisles.
stillPrompt: Mid-close of glass refrigerated cases inside the Kaufhaus: contents replaced by dense red bundles and glossy condensation streaks; overhead spotlights narrow. No people, no text or logos.
videoPrompt: 2s lateral pan at floor level following a dark red smear as it runs from the case into the grated channel toward the central floor, ambient refrigeration hum.
cameraCue: After the smear appears, handheld low pan tracking the smear as it drains under a crate toward the next aisle.

title: H- und P-Sätze: the Vapor Emerges
event: Warning strobes in the lighting pattern trigger the condensation over the red bundles to bloom into a dense, oily vapor; the vapor coheres, pulls itself from behind a toppled refrigerated crate and unrolls into a liminal creature — a slick, folding form of reflective, vacuum-formed membranes and wet fabric that slithers across tile, leaving a trail of phosphorescent powder and knocking a crate over.
consequence: A toppled refrigerated crate lies split open on the floor; a trail of phosphorescent powder and small scattered packaged goods leads away toward the atrium.
nextHook: The scattered packaged goods tumble along the trail toward the central shopper area and escalator.
stillPrompt: Creature materializing from a mist in a Kaufhaus aisle: a slick, folding form of reflective membranes and wet fabric emerging beside a toppled refrigerated crate, strobe-lit reflections on tiles, no readable text or logos.
videoPrompt: 3s camera rises from floor level as oily vapor condenses into a slithering creature that uncoils from behind a crate and slides across reflective tile, leaving a glowing powder trail; tight ambient mechanical and fizzing sounds.
cameraCue: After the creature forms, crane up from floor to reveal its full length and the scattered goods leading toward the shopper area.

title: The Public Rings
event: Shoppers in the central atrium, drawn by the disturbance, fall into synchronized, procedural movement: they step over the glowing powder trail, form a tight ring around the toppled crate and clutch goods like shields, each performing the same practiced gesture as if in a public drill; a small child loses hold of a rubber toy which bounces away along the powder trail.
consequence: A small rubber toy bounces out of the human ring and rolls down the glowing powder trail toward the escalator.
nextHook: The toy's bounce traces the powder trail toward the escalator where the upper-level circulation can be seen.
stillPrompt: Mid-shot of an atrium ring of shoppers inside the Kaufhaus: people clutching goods, faces tense, synchronized posture forming a circular barrier around a toppled crate, architecture of balconies visible above, no monster, no text or logos.
videoPrompt: 2s steady cam circle around the human ring as a small rubber toy slips from a child's grip and bounces away along the luminous powder trail toward the escalator.
cameraCue: After the ring forms, orbit around the people to conceal earlier positions and focus on the bouncing toy moving down the trail.

title: Rupture: Banner and Shrapnel
event: A sudden metallic boom reverberates; lights shudder and a ceiling panel tears away. Panic ruptures the human ring into chaotic motion as the creature bursts back through the knocked crate, ripping fixtures and hurling merchandise like shrapnel; a large fabric banner is torn free and flutters down from the skylight, drifting across the atrium while broken consumer items spin through the air.
consequence: A torn banner flutters toward the escalator and a scattered field of broken goods forms a jagged barricade where the ring used to be.
nextHook: The fluttering torn banner wraps briefly around an escalator railing and points toward the checkout corridor.
stillPrompt: Wide handheld of the Kaufhaus atrium at moment of rupture: a torn ceiling panel and fluttering banner visible against the skylight, scattered goods tumbling in midair and a shadowed creature silhouette seizing items, no readable text or logos.
videoPrompt: 5s chaotic handheld weave through falling merchandise as the creature rips a display and a banner tears from the skylight, alarms and metallic bangs punctuating the fall; shoppers scatter.
cameraCue: After the explosion, whip pan from the torn skylight down to the banner wrapping the escalator, briefly silhouetting the creature against the opening.

title: Consumption Resolves
event: The aftermath morphs into a marketlike response: strewn goods and the torn banner are pulled together as the creature presses items into its mouth; on contact each object dissolves into small glowing tokens that settle into neat, ordered piles on nearby counters and a makeshift pyramid of goods forms where the barricade was. People, stunned, begin grabbing and rearranging the tokens into stacks—commerce resumes as a physical reordering.
consequence: Neat pyramid stacks of converted tokens and reordered goods appear on the counter; tills clatter back into motion and a shopping cart rolls out emptied but upright.
nextHook: A shopping cart, filled and then suddenly emptied of glowing tokens, rolls slowly out of frame toward the street-facing exit.
stillPrompt: Close frame of the creature's hand pressing consumer items and them dissolving into small glowing cube-like tokens which are stacked into neat piles on a Kaufhaus counter; customers begin to gather tokens, no readable text or logos.
videoPrompt: 2s quick dolly in on tokens forming into neat stacks as lights steady and tills resume clatter, the creature looming at the edge of frame; ambient shift from alarm to low mechanical hum.
cameraCue: After the transformation, close tilt down to the newly formed pyramid of goods and stacks of glowing tokens to finish on an ordered frame.
